correctness.rationale: For C48:x^4+y^4+xz^3=0 over C, at z=1 substitution along the tangent vector (4b^3,-(4a^3+1)) yields quadratic coefficient 6b^2(1-8a^3) after b^4=-a^4-a. The independent symbolic cubic coefficient becomes 27b when a^3=1/8, excluding all b≠0 hyperflexes. For b=0, a^4+a=0 and the line x=az restricts F to y^4, proving order four; z=0 points have contact three. Four roots 0,-1,α,1-α, α²-α+1=0, have cross-ratio α and projective stabilizer A4. The group order 48 is explicitly prior input; coefficient comparison for projective automorphisms fixing the four collinear contact points forces p=r=0,q^4=1, so kernel is C4 and image order 12=A4. No independent proof of group order is claimed.
